Evidence/CLM-037
Evidence record

The paths align after normalization; their levels are not equivalent

What does this evidence establish?

When the remittance series in the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) Annual Report 2025 and in the IMF 2025 Article IV consultation are each indexed to 2021 = 100, the two paths are almost identical through 2024: the largest difference in annual growth over 2022–2024 is 0.0032 percentage points. Over 2021–2024 the ratio of the CBY-Aden level to the IMF level is 1.838 in every year. The two indexed paths move almost identically, but this does not show that the raw levels share the same scope.

What does it measure?

The annual growth paths of the CBY-Aden and IMF remittance series, each indexed to 2021 = 100, compared over 2021–2024.

Who or what does it apply to?

The remittance series published by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and the IMF series for areas under the internationally recognized government; the exact territorial and conceptual mapping between them remains open

When was it measured or observed?

Reference years 2021–2024 (indexed comparison), from the CBY-Aden Annual Report 2025 and the IMF 2025 Article IV consultation

How current is it?

The latest year compared is 2024, from the CBY-Aden Annual Report 2025 and the IMF 2025 Article IV consultation. It should not be read as describing a later period unless newer comparable editions of both series are published.

What this evidence does not establish

The raw CBY-Aden and IMF levels are not equivalent, and the stable level ratio of 1.838 over 2021–2024 is not a geographic conversion factor.

Limits of the measure

When indexed, the two series move almost identically, but no published crosswalk states how CBY-Aden and IMF levels, geography and statistical concepts correspond; a same-year revision remains distinct from change over time.

Method and verification detailAdditional detail for reproducing or challenging the reading without changing the evidence meaning.

How was it produced?

Computed by this resource from published values: the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) Annual Report 2025 remittance series (2,900.22; 3,066.58; 3,240.46; 3,422.16 US$ million for 2021–2024) and the IMF 2025 Article IV staff-report series (1,577.7; 1,668.2; 1,762.8; 1,861.7 US$ million). Each series is divided by its 2021 value and multiplied by 100; annual growth rates are then compared for 2022–2024, and the level ratio is the CBY-Aden value divided by the IMF value for each year.
